definitions.code_prose: Median SSE decode after first emitted token; three timed trials per task following excluded warmup.
definitions.prefill: Median native N or engine-phase E prefill, three fresh salted marker prompts; never input tokens divided by TTFT.
definitions.TTFT: Median fresh first reasoning/content token; model loading excluded.
definitions.context: Configured capacity; distinct from exercised prompt length.
definitions.storage: Decimal allocated associated-file GB from October 27 inventory; shared sets counted once.
definitions.image_request: Fresh-server request, encoder/model loading, sampling, decode and save included; server readiness separate.
definitions.H3_request: Reused completed matched 32 GB requests exclude encoder costs.
definitions.comparison_limit: Sequential small samples, natural file caching and desktop/storage/thermal variation; no causal RAM scaling claim.
definitions.image_phases: Synchronized wall spans by label; nested text/load spans overlap and must not be summed. GPU load calls omit earlier filesystem reads, so phase sums do not equal complete requests.
definitions.swap: Peak worker swap is occupancy, not cumulative SSD writes. Lifecycle swap-in/out counters and observed inference-window sample counts are separate. Rate fields with zero inference-window samples are unmeasured, not evidence of zero inference paging.

guards.swap_policy: loading-swap-v3; occupancy, reads, rates and PSI advisory; OS oomd unchanged
guards.native_placement_guard_scope: The native VRAM reserve/hard floors apply to Super/Ornith placement experiments. Resident framework profiles retain their separate unchanged launcher/admission/runtime limits.

limits: One prompt/seed, 608x352x39 (1.625s), 20 steps; three fresh-server timed trials per arm. No maximum-capacity or long-video qualification.
Fresh servers with natural OS file caching/paging; not controlled cold-file or persistent-resident performance. These times exclude all text-encoder costs.
Common loader/source/conditioning/CPU seed narrows prior confounders, but one versus distributed rank lifecycle and numerics still differ. No GPU-count-only causal/kernel-scaling claim.
All full AV decodes pass; sampled frames show coherent teapot/wood/plant/steam, with steam-spout attachment only partial. No exhaustive motion, semantic audio or bitwise-parity qualification.
Memory/sensors are one-second sampled lifecycle observations, not guaranteed transient extrema. Scope memory.peak includes charged file cache; worker swap occupancy differs from whole-host swap I/O.
SMU thermal/hotspot/power flags are reported sample counts, including on the idle second card, not measured throttling time or proof of thermal causation.
Initial snapshot setup failures before generation remain classified as harness failures; no completed R2 trial is excluded beyond the planned two warmups.
